messages.author: LumaLux
messages.text:
hey there I am having the same issues. 

Dropping the twozero tox into a running TD session works perfectly (live inject — plugin, MCP, everything functional). But the install step also writes a patched ui.tox into Config/System/ inside the TD program install. On the next TD launch, that persisted patch causes TD to exit silently. Reverting ui.tox to TD's stock version fixes it every time, with 100% reproducibility across 3+ cycles and 4 different machines. 

for now my way around is having Windows UAC notification thing on level 3 and clicking "no" when the installer throws the consent prompt becuause it wants to write in a protected location.  official bug report was made 2 days ago via native td_submit_report tool.

If double clicking the installer is the actual solution for now, I would recommend updating the installation doc page. I had a hard time finding the issue and see a high possibility of newer touch users having no clue at all what is going on

---

Hey — thanks for the report. We reproduced that textport error and have a fix coming, but it's not what's blocking your connection — it's a harmless leftover check, unrelated to the MCP server.

The connection issue is most likely just timing: Claude connects to the server only once, when the chat starts, and doesn't retry. This is standard Claude behavior — if the chat is opened before the MCP server is up (e.g. TD / port 40404 not fully loaded yet), that session stays disconnected the whole time, even if onboarding shows "✓ CONNECTED" (that only checks your config, not a live connection).

Two things to try:

With TD fully loaded, open a brand-new chat and ask if the twozero_td tools are there.
,
In a terminal: curl http://localhost:40404/ — JSON back = server's fine, just timing. Connection refused = server didn't start, tell us and we'll dig in.
,

messages.author: mykul0rr
messages.text:
Environment: Windows 11 Pro, TouchDesigner 2025.33230, plugin versions tried: 3.269, 3.332, 3.333, 3.34 (all reproduce)

Symptom: Port 40404 never binds, TWOZERO window permanently shows "disconnected port 40404," despite Settings → MCP → Auto start = Yes, Local only = Yes, Port = 40404.
https://github.com/404dotzero/twozero-td-mcp/issues

A solution for me which is working is a bat file:

@echo off
REM Manually starts the TwoZero MCP proxy server on port 40404.
REM Workaround for the TD plugin's auto-launcher not spawning it on this PC.
REM Leave this window open while you want the MCP server running; closing it stops the
server.

"C:\Program Files\Derivative\TouchDesigner\bin\python.exe" "%LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp\pisang_
mcp\proxy_server.py" --port 40404 --installation-id a1e6f3c2b9d84f7e9a2c5b1d0e6f7a3c --
plugin-version 3.34 --tdmcp-proxy

echo.
echo Proxy process exited. Press any key to close.
pause >nul

Save the bat file, double-click it any time after opening TouchDesigner, and leave the window open while you want the server running (closing it stops the proxy). It uses the same command line and a fixed installation ID so it behaves consistently across restarts.

Hope this helps
